title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
style: 深蓝描边机器人流程图
description: As illustrated in Figure 4, EvoMemState organizes personal memory around Persistent Facts and two complementary states. Ontology-Guided Memory State Induction extracts Persistent Facts from accumulated personal information and constructs Relational States that track their validity, scope, and evolving relations.
author: XLCYun

images.caption: Overview of EvoMemState for personal agents. Ontology-guided induction transforms accumulated personal information into Persistent Facts and Relational States. RL-based state evolution learns a Memory State Evolution Policy from memory-use experience and generates a request-specific Reasoning State. State-Aware Reasoning combines the Relational States and Reasoning State to guide the personal agent’s response.
